sentence: The students must cross a bridge to get to their class on time.
synonym: walk over a bridge to arrive at class punctually
synonymNote: 两者都表示过桥并准时到达课堂，意思相同。

distractors.word: build a bridge to reach their classroom early
distractors.note: build表示建造桥梁，而非走过桥，意思不同。

distractors.word: swim under a bridge to find their classroom
distractors.note: swim under表示从桥下游过，方向和动作完全不同。

distractors.word: run past a bridge to get to their school
distractors.note: run past表示跑过桥旁边，没有穿越桥的意思。
